# Catppuccin

The Catppuccin colour palette, taken unaltered and used as the colours of
`rolltui/presets/themes/catppuccin.json`. Only the palette is used; the role mapping that turns
those colours into this library's 49 roles is our own.

- Upstream: https://github.com/catppuccin/catppuccin
